subject: Gemini 4 Neon 🧠, OpenAI Chip Model +14% PPA 🔧, Devin Bots 🤖

stories.headline: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens
stories.quote: Priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens
stories.description: Gemini 4 Neon, a model between the cheaper Hydrogen and Carbon

facts.text: Gemini 4 Neon is priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.
facts.quote: Priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens

facts.text: Gemini 4 Neon sits between the cheaper Hydrogen and the more powerful Carbon.
facts.quote: Gemini 4 Neon , a new model sitting between the cheaper Hydrogen and the more powerful Carbon.

facts.text: 1M token context window shared across input, thinking and output.
facts.quote: 1M token context window shared across input, thinking, and output, so you can feed it entire codebases or long documents

facts.text: Four thinking levels: low, medium, high and xhigh.
facts.quote: Four thinking levels: low, medium, high, and xhigh, so you control how hard it thinks and what you spend

facts.text: The issue's headline ranks it #3 on the Intelligence Index.
facts.quote: Google DeepMind ships Gemini 4 Neon, ranking #3 on the Intelligence Index

facts.text: Available via the Gemini API, AI Studio and Android Studio.
facts.quote: You can use it right now via the Gemini API, AI Studio, and Android Studio with model ID gemini-4-neon

stories.headline: OpenAI's chip design models found up to 14% PPA improvement on AMD's flagship GPU
stories.quote: OpenAI's chip design model delivers 14% hardware gains on AMD's GPU

facts.text: Working with AMD, OpenAI's models rewrote chip circuit code and found up to 14% PPA (power, performance, area) improvement on AMD's flagship GPU.
facts.quote: OpenAI's models rewrote chip circuit code and found up to 14% PPA improvement on AMD's flagship GPU.

facts.text: The issue describes this as roughly a year of progress in less than five months.
facts.quote: That's roughly a year of progress achieved in less than five months.

facts.text: AMD has included some of the changes in a recent design sent for manufacturing.
facts.quote: AMD has already included some changes in a recent design sent for manufacturing, with others added to production files for future versions.

facts.text: OpenAI applied the same approach to Jalapeño, its own custom chip, with gains confirmed on real silicon.
facts.quote: Jalapeño , its own custom chip built to run AI models, with gains confirmed on real silicon.

facts.text: GPT-Synopsys is a new model trained to use Synopsys EDA tools.
facts.quote: GPT-Synopsys : a new model trained to use Synopsys EDA tools the way expert chip designers do.

stories.headline: Cognition launches Devin Bots, an AI manager that runs multiple Devin agents in parallel
stories.quote: Cognition launches Devin Bots, helping engineers merge 4.5x more PRs

facts.text: A Bot takes a goal, breaks it into tasks and runs multiple Devin agents in parallel.
facts.quote: The Bot takes a big goal, breaks it into tasks, spins up multiple Devin agents to work in parallel, checks their output, and only pings you when a real decision is needed.

facts.text: Beta testers are reported to merge 4.5x more pull requests per message.
facts.quote: Beta testers are merging 4.5x more pull requests per message.

facts.text: One team is reported to have gone from 50 to nearly 2,000 PRs a week.
facts.quote: One team went from 50 to nearly 2,000 PRs a week
